title: 第一卷 第8章 扣钱？扣谁的钱？
slug: 全网黑上恋综后我爆红了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

第二天早上，宋尔尔是被敲门声叫醒的。

她睁开眼，看了眼手机。

七点二十。

节目组工作人员在门外小声提醒：“尔尔老师，八点直播，今天有情侣默契挑战。”

宋尔尔坐起来，沉默三秒。

三个词拆开她都认识，合在一起就很像加班。

她洗漱完下楼时，客厅已经摆好了三组答题板。

主持人站在中间，笑容饱满得像刚充过电。

“各位老师早上好！今天我们的任务是情侣默契挑战。”

宋尔尔刚坐下，听见这句，抬头问：“能改名吗？”

主持人一愣：“改成什么？”

宋尔尔：“同事协作能力测试。”

主持人：“……”

陆执正好从厨房出来，手里拿着一杯水，听见这句，脚步顿了一下。

周闻野坐在沙发上，点头：“我觉得这个名字比较准确。”

姜眠小声附和：“是比较不尴尬。”

主持人看向导演棚方向。

耳机里传来刘导压低的声音：“别理她，继续。”

主持人笑容不变：“我们今天还是以情侣默契挑战为准，规则很简单，每组嘉宾背对背回答同一个问题，答案一致得一分，分数最高的小组可以获得今晚的优先约会权。”

宋尔尔举手。

主持人眼皮跳了一下。

“尔尔有什么问题？”

宋尔尔：“优先约会权可以折现吗？”

主持人：“……不能。”

宋尔尔：“那它的吸引力略低。”

陆执在她旁边坐下，语气平稳：“你可以理解成选择晚饭地点。”

宋尔尔立刻坐直：“那有点吸引力了。”

弹幕刚开播就笑疯。

【姐，你对浪漫过敏但胃很诚实。】

【陆执已经掌握了和宋尔尔沟通的核心：别谈心，谈饭。】

【这不叫情侣默契，这叫职场搭档团建。】

顾南舟坐在对面，看着两人一来一回，脸色不算好。

他昨天一整晚都没睡好。

准确地说，从宋尔尔问他什么时候还钱开始，他就没睡好过。

节目组原本安排他和林栀一组，是想制造“前任与新欢”的微妙张力。

可现在问题是，宋尔尔压根不接他的戏。

她不吃醋，不失落，不嘴硬。

她只惦记钱。

顾南舟第一次觉得，前任太清醒也不是什么好事。

主持人开始宣布分组。

“第一组，顾南舟和林栀。”

林栀笑着点头：“我们会努力的。”

顾南舟也笑：“希望能有默契。”

镜头给到宋尔尔。

Page (1/3)

The next morning, Song Er'er was woken up by a knock on the door.

She opened her eyes and looked at her phone.

Seven twenty.

The program staff reminded in a low voice outside the door: "Teacher Er'er, live broadcast at 8 o'clock, there is a couple's tacit understanding challenge today."

Song Er'er sat up and was silent for three seconds.

She knew all three words separately, but together they looked like overtime.

When she went downstairs after washing, three sets of answer boards were already set up in the living room.

The host stood in the middle, smiling as if he had just been recharged.

"Good morning, teachers! Today our task is the couple's chemistry challenge."

As soon as Song Er'er sat down, he heard this and raised his head and asked, "Can I change my name?"

The host was stunned: "Change it to what?"

Song Er'er: "Colleague collaboration ability test."

Host: "..."

Lu Zhi happened to come out of the kitchen with a glass of water in his hand. When he heard this, he paused.

Zhou Wenye sat on the sofa and nodded: "I think this name is more accurate."

Jiang Mian whispered in agreement: "It's less embarrassing."

The host looked in the direction of the director's studio.

Director Liu's low voice came from the earphones: "Ignore her and continue."

The host's smile remained unchanged: "Today we are still based on the couple's tacit understanding challenge. The rules are very simple. Each group of guests answers the same question back to back. If the answer is consistent, they will get one point. The group with the highest score can get the priority date tonight."

Songer raised his hand.

The host's eyelids twitched.

"Er, what's the problem?"

Song Er'er: "Can the priority dating rights be discounted?"

Host: "...can't."

Song Er'er: "Then it's slightly less attractive."

Lu Zhi sat down next to her and said in a calm tone: "You can understand it as choosing a place for dinner."

Song Er'er immediately sat up straight: "That's a bit attractive."

The barrage started laughing like crazy.

[Sister, you are allergic to romance but your stomach is very honest.】

[Lu Zhi has mastered the core of communication with Song Er'er: don't talk about hearts, talk about food.】

[This is not called tacit understanding as a couple, this is called team building as workplace partners.】

Gu Nanzhou sat across from him, looking at the two people going back and forth, his face not looking good.

He didn't sleep well all night last night.

To be precise, he had not slept well since Song Er'er asked him when he would pay back the money.

The program team originally arranged for him to be paired with Lin Zhi in order to create a subtle tension between the ex and the new love.

But the problem now is that Song Er'er doesn't accept his role at all.

She is not jealous, frustrated or harsh.

All she cared about was money.

For the first time, Gu Nanzhou felt that it was not a good thing for his ex to be too sober.

The host began to announce the groups.

"The first group, Gu Nanzhou and Lin Zhi."

Lin Zhi smiled and nodded: "We will work hard."

Gu Nanzhou also smiled: "I hope there can be a tacit understanding."

The camera shows Song Er'er.
